entities.summary: Jizi (Kija) allegedly fled the Chinese Shang dynasty to the Korean Peninsula, where he founded the dynastic state of Kija Chosŏn and eventually succeeded Dangun as king of Gojoseon. Legend says that Kija brought to the Korean people many skills from China, such as agriculture and weaving; he is also credited with founding the city of Pyongyang.
